activation_after: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH typed MCS start gates; parallel-safe with MCCS/MRCS/MSAS
successor: cross-program activation remains ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH-owned; MCCS is parallel-safe rather than strict successor

execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a surviving MCS tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries it through implementation, required validation, verified closeout and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected surviving tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated source archaeology and other-family work.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, evidence verification, reconciliation and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: Split before governed start if the selected surviving tranche cannot credibly preserve the closeout reserve.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: MCS is map-specific authoring/presentation tooling and does not become canonical World, Scene, Combat, Exploration, Visibility, Settlement, Economy, built-environment or spatial-law authority
map elements explicitly distinguish presentation-only, owner-projected and binding-proposal states
pixels, vectors, labels, imported metadata and generator output never silently create canonical game/world truth
MAI retains map-asset/package schemas and projection/grid/scale foundations; MCS is the creator-facing editor over them
ISE/Scene/Tabletop retain live canvas, placement, camera and runtime interaction; MCS tactical tools author inputs/proposals/previews only
SSA/World/reduced MSLR retain semantic spatial/runtime topology truth; MCS supplies cartographic bindings/proposals only
PCA-02/PCA-03 retain generic procedural DAG/recipe/seed/cache and spatial generator infrastructure; MCS-10 supplies map-specific generator packs and UX only
PCA-12/Packet-08 retain generic analysis/solvability/optimization engines; MCS supplies spatial/map adapters only
ARI/PCA retain generic identity/rights/provenance/version/review/import-export governance; MCS-19 supplies map-specific serialization/loss/conflict/publication adapters
PCA-09/ARI retain generic style-generation/resource governance; MCS-07 supplies cartographic style/layout/profile authoring
Settlement/World/reduced MBES retain built-environment truth; MCS-13/MCS-14 author cartographic projections only
Combat/Visibility/Exploration/reduced MSWI retain runtime state and consequences; MCS authors/projections cannot adjudicate them
Packet 07 retains generic preview/recovery/debug/collaboration semantics; MCS supplies map-domain operations/lenses
generic DCC/CAD/GIS/vector/raster capabilities use lawful mature libraries/tools where practical rather than being rebuilt as general-purpose applications
no paid mapping provider is required for blocking workflows
no MCS implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a surviving MCS work item
